description: Enrichment layer 3: domain evidence (RDAP registration dates, DNS records, one homepage fetch, platform fingerprints) for a brand's VERIFIED website only. Every check is free, rate-limited, time-outed and fail-soft: a failure leaves the signal empty and records an error, it never blocks a run. Nothing here changes a score while the matching indicators in config/scoring.json have weight 0. Read by src/enrich/domain/.
_comment: Keys starting with '_' are comments. The master switch is the DOMAIN_LAYER_ENABLED setting; the per-check flags below switch individual checks off.

domain_selection._comment: Which domain to probe. Only a domain we have reason to believe is the brand's: the entity-verified website first. Unverified candidate websites are off by default (D-201): probing a stranger's domain would attribute their registration date and shop to this brand. Domains are never guessed from brand names.
domain_selection._max_domains_per_run_note: A cap on distinct domains probed per run. Each probe is at most: 1 RDAP request (+1 bootstrap refresh per refresh_days), 3 DNS queries, 1 robots.txt and 1-2 homepage requests (plus redirects).
domain_selection._skip_hosts_note: A website on one of these hosts (or a subdomain of one) is a marketplace, social, retailer or shared-platform page, not the brand's own domain. Its RDAP date and DNS describe the platform, so it is never probed.
domain_selection._multi_label_suffixes_note: Public suffixes with two labels, used to reduce a host to its registrable domain (shop.brand.co.uk -> brand.co.uk). Not the full Public Suffix List; an unlisted suffix falls back to the last two labels.

rdap._bootstrap_note: The IANA bootstrap file maps each TLD to its RDAP server. Cached on disk under CACHE_DIR/rdap/dns.json and refreshed after bootstrap_refresh_days. If it cannot be fetched, the fallback_bases below are used.
rdap._min_interval_note: Minimum spacing between two requests to the same RDAP server. Nominet and Verisign publish rate limits; one request a second stays well inside them.
rdap._max_bytes_note: Bodies are streamed and abandoned past these sizes (256 KB for a domain answer, 1 MB for the IANA bootstrap file) before any JSON is parsed: error rdap_response_too_large.
rdap._backoff_on_429_note: After a 429 the server is not asked again for this many seconds; the domains it would have answered are recorded as not fetched (error rdap_rate_limited).

homepage._max_bytes_note: The body is streamed and reading stops at this size (512 KB). Enough for fingerprints, which sit in the <head> and the first screen.
homepage._ssrf_note: Every hop (robots.txt, the page, each redirect) must be http(s) on the default port and resolve only to public addresses; anything else stops the fetch with blocked_private_address / blocked_scheme / blocked_port (DECISIONS.md D-701).

platforms._comment: Fingerprints: a platform is detected when any html marker (case-insensitive substring of the body) or header marker (header name present, or name:value-substring) matches. Checked in order; first match wins, so specific shop platforms come before generic WordPress.

holding_page._comment: A page that exists but is not a trading site yet: a registrar parking page, a 'coming soon' splash or a builder's default. A very short visible body with no store markers is also treated as a holding page.
phrases: sign up to be the first
holding_page._parking_hosts_note: A homepage that redirects to one of these, or whose HTML loads assets from one, is a parked domain. GoDaddy's own parking page is matched by redirect target only.
holding_page._min_visible_text_chars_note: Below this many characters of visible text (tags and scripts stripped), with no store markers, the page counts as a holding page.

store_markers._comment: Evidence the site sells online today. Any one marker counts.

web_presence_stage._comment: Ordered rules: the first whose conditions all hold sets web_presence_stage. Conditions are facts computed by src/enrich/domain/layer.py (stage_for): has_domain, has_dns, homepage_fetched, redirected_to_marketplace, is_parked, is_holding_page, store_detected, shop_platform. A fact that was not established (null) never satisfies a condition. A homepage that redirects to a marketplace or social host is 'unknown': the page fetched is not the brand's own. A shop platform (Shopify, WooCommerce, Big Cartel, Ecwid) that is not a holding page counts as a live store.

scoring_features._comment: Parameters for the domain indicators in config/scoring.json (all weight 0 today).
scoring_features._domain_registered_recently_note: domain_registered_recently fires when the RDAP registration date is no more than this many days before the trade mark filing date (or any time after it).
